title: Which patient has a normal proteinuria level and is diagnosed with SLE? Ple
question:
Which patient has a normal proteinuria level and is diagnosed with SLE? Please give his or her patient ID.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal proteinuria level refers to 0 < `U-PRO` < 30; diagnosed with SLE refers to Diagnosis = 'SLE';

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_058
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_064 = 'SLE'
  AND l.XCL_041 IN ('1', '2')
